slug: 2025-07-31 Eswatini's Digital Transformation Crucial to Unlocking Growth, Jobs, and Economic Resilience

facts.fact: The Minister for Economic Planning and Development, Thambo Gina, is quoted on 2025-07-31 saying the World Bank report 'aligns with the Kingdom of Eswatini's 2024-2028 digital strategy', which puts the strategy within its stated 2024-2028 period. Text public: not stated.
